usage: The word "sik1 jik6" is a noun referring to a small reptile commonly known as a lizard.
"Sik1 jik6" can be used when talking about animals seen in gardens or homes.
You can use "sik1 jik6" to describe both wild and pet lizards.
In sentences, "sik1 jik6" usually functions as the subject or object when talking about reptiles.
It is a countable noun, so you can say "yat1 go3 sik1 jik6" (one lizard).
